# telnyx_telephony_credential_token_material (Ephemeral Resource)

The key material a server needs to mint login tokens for a telephony credential itself, without asking Telnyx for each token. It is never stored in state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Read-Only

- `kid` (String, Sensitive) Identifies the Telnyx signing key the `signing_secret` was derived with. Goes in the token header.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) The HMAC-SHA256 key the token is signed with, base64url without padding.
- `tel_token` (String, Sensitive) Opaque value Telnyx uses to resolve the credential. Carried in the token's `tel_token` claim as is.
